violated_contract: A container's memory limit must cover its measured burst peak, not its steady state. Grafana in prod-omi-monitoring held a 2Gi limit sized from a 260-510Mi steady state; overlapping Omi TV dashboard loads (each about +140Mi for two minutes) and other bursts reached 2048Mi on 2026-11-12 09:02Z and OOM-killed the pod, taking monitor.omi.me (both orgs) offline for the restart. A Go service in the pod should also carry a soft memory limit below the container limit so the runtime collects before the kernel kills.
canonical_prevention: The prod values pin Grafana's limit above the measured burst peak and set GOMEMLIMIT below the limit; the monitoring contract test asserts both so a later trim cannot silently reopen the window.
